verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official `notte` CLI that lets AI agents control browsers through shell commands, with concrete subcommands such as `notte page observe`. The docs also cover generating workflow code with the CLI, using it in Claude Code and Claude managed-agent integrations, and getting started via the quickstart. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the CLI's full command surface and installation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
